one_liner: Album owners can revoke and expire invite links and remove any photo, replacing today's permanent links.
bullets: Revoking rotates the album token: every outstanding link dies at once and a new one is issued.
Links get an expiry; the default lifetime is still undecided.
Breaking: permanent links are removed and existing ones expire 30 days after release.
Owners can delete any member's photo; members only their own.
Owners are emailed 3 days before a link expires.
you_must_decide: Default link lifetime (7, 30 or 90 days), which the migration already assumes is 30.
Whether members who joined through a revoked link keep their access.
Whether the expiry email's 'extend' button is in scope: no requirement or task covers extending a link.

decisions.title: Remove permanent links, expire existing ones after 30 days
decisions.choice: Breaking change: permanent invite links go away; links created before release expire 30 days after it.
decisions.rationale: Permanent links cannot be revoked and are the product's main privacy risk.
alternatives: Keep permanent links but allow revocation
decisions.risk: Families relying on an old link lose access without noticing; the 30-day grace period is fixed before the default lifetime is decided.

decisions.title: Revoke by rotating the token
decisions.choice: Revoking replaces the album's token with a new random one instead of keeping a denylist.
decisions.rationale: A denylist grows forever and must be checked on every join.
decisions.risk: Rotation also kills legitimate links already shared with relatives.

decisions.title: Expiry stored next to the token, lifetime from configuration
decisions.choice: Each token has an expires_at; the default lifetime is a configuration value.
decisions.rationale: The lifetime can change without a migration.

decisions.title: Only owners moderate photos
decisions.choice: The owner can delete any photo; members can delete only their own.
decisions.rationale: Closes the abuse path of open upload links.
decisions.risk: Deleted photos disappear for everyone, with no undo or audit trail specified.

risks.title: Migration hard-codes 30 days while the default lifetime is open
risks.impact: If the team picks 7 or 90 days, existing and new links follow different rules.
risks.mitigation: Derive the migration expiry from the configured default, or decide the default first.

risks.title: The expiry email promises an action nobody builds
risks.impact: The notification offers a button to extend the link, but no requirement or task covers extending.
risks.mitigation: Add an 'Extend invite link' requirement and task, or drop the button from the scenario.

risks.title: No tasks for tests
risks.impact: Rotation, expiry and the migration change access control with no planned verification.
risks.mitigation: Add contract tests for rotate and expired join, and a migration test.

questions.question: Can a deleted photo be restored, and is the deletion logged?
questions.why_it_matters: Owner moderation is irreversible as written, across every member's view.
